newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain expects CPI to pick up toward 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain expects CPI to pick up toward 2 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Spain said in its yearly report published on Tuesday that although the consumer price index's recent moderation is likely to stop, Spain's CPI should remain below two percent in 1997.
Spanish May CPI rose at a yearly 1.5 percent, down from 1.7 percent in April.

The possibility of the pick-up in Spanish inflation, however, would not endanger the country's possibilities of meeting the Maastricht requirement in terms of CPI, central bank governor Luis Angel Rojo said in an address accompanying the annual report.
